notes.title: Glitchangels: Intense Action Arcade Battle Arena
notes.notes:
📢 A NEW THRILLING ARCADE EXPERIENCE! 📢

Secure your copy now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1170300/Glitchangels/

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705432/8c80f8b88a29d0eef62a93173de739ca8b6ec7fc.gif[/img]

LOAD "GLITCHANGELS", 8, 1

After months of blood, sweat and tears - it's finally here! This is the latest of the collaborations with other indie devs that Puppygames has been working with recently, this time with Pumpkin Games.

Deploy your team of Glitchangels to repair 'THE SYSTEM', one corrupt subroutine at a time.

Navigate your way through a cacophony of procedurally generated levels, unlocking GLITCHES as you go. Weapon powerups, extra bullets, enhanced vision, monster crates, etc –temporary hacks that help you complete your mission - or indeed hinder you if you’re unlucky.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705432/c948eedfec7d0068d834aafb7a1af963850f4ca5.gif[/img]


Battle deranged HUNTERS, avoid deadly TRAPS, defeat the powerful archangels in HEAVEN – these APPS (and others) can be disabled so you can dial down the madness if you fancy a more chilled play session.


Glitchangels' coolest feature is to REWIND TIME when you get blown up. Go back 5 seconds in time and try something different to cheat death (and switch Angels while you're at it!)

What are you waiting for? It's out NOW on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1170300/Glitchangels/

As always, many thanks to our generous Patreons for their feedback during testing :)

https://patreon.com/puppygames

notes.title: Mac versions working again!
notes.notes:
At some unknown point quite some time ago the Mac versions of all our games stopped working, coinciding with some update or other that was out of our hands. Unfortunately... I don't have a working Mac any more and I certainly can't afford to buy one! So it remained unfixed for a long time.

This week, I've fixed it by removing Steam's tendrils from the Mac code, and all is well again.

Also, ICYMI, we have a Discord now, which is [url=https://discord.gg/hj6eUV]here[/url].

And we're making a new game, the successor to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/203210/Titan_Attacks/]Revenge of the Titans[/url] (which is on sale in the Summer Sale!), and it's called Battledroid, but [url=https://www.patreon.com/puppygames]we need your help![/url]

notes.title: Basingstoke
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953219/ce07f84869228010614efe047e42b3371d25c91a.png[/img]

[h1]Basingstoke Is Nearly Here[/h1]

Minions! Let is be known that our vicious roguelike survival horror game [b]BASINGSTOKE[/b] is due for release on [b]Mar 30, 2018 @ 11:00am PST[/b]. Go forth and [url=store.steampowered.com/app/336940/Basingstoke]wishlist it[/url] so you'll get a reminder when it finally appears (with a wee discount).

[h1]Eh? What's Basingstoke?[/h1]

We've spent the last [b]four years[/b] making a game about escaping a mediocre small town in southern England. Set in the near future, Basingstoke has been invaded by the evil Titans, and nearly everyone has been killed by a neutron bomb. [i]Nearly[/i] everyone...

You've got to escape alive through Basingstoke's randomly generated suburban sprawl, looting bodies as you go, crafting new things to help you evade detection, distract your enemies, or just plain old kill them as a last resort. Everything you encounter will kill you instantly, so stealth and planning are the keys to survival. And running away a lot while throwing sausage rolls over your shoulder.

A few more details can be found [url=http://www.puppygames.net/basingstoke]here[/url] on our site.

notes.title: Christmas Droid Factory Disaster!
notes.notes:
We have accidentally boxed hundreds of deadly battledroids in festive wrapping, ready for shipping to little orphaned children! Please send in a Z001 Infiltration robot to destroy them all before they're posted. Think of the children!

This special Christmas game mode appears only over the festive season - play it while it's there!

notes.title: Droid Assault 1.91.8 Released
notes.notes:
Very minor tweaks here, but hopefully appreciated:

[list]
[*] You should be seeing the Super Health a lot more often now
[*] Ordinary health pickups now repair your droid max hitpoints by 12.5% 
[*] Droids which have no use of bouncy bullets or sharp bullets (eg. the disruptor weapons and flamers) won't be able to pick those powerups up
[/list]

notes.title: Droid Assault 1.91.7 released
notes.notes:
Complete with still experimental controller support. There are some options you can use to change the way the controls work on the options screen.

The most important change though now is that every time you complete a checkpoint, your entire squad is saved, along with your score and number of transfer points. Hurrah! It will overwrite any existing checkpoint if you go back a few and try again.

I hope you enjoy that particular tweak :)

The RPG DLC is coming along nicely, and should be with us in the next 2 months at most, and will be super cheap.

notes.title: Now Available - Droid Assault, 20% off!
notes.notes:
Droid Assault, from the creators of Revenge of the Titans, is now available on Steam and 20% off*!

Discover a unique tactical arcade shooter, with the fun addictive gameplay of 8-bit classics. You'll need your wits and the help of your acquired droid squad to stay alive in this fast-paced retro actionfest. Wreak havok through 50 atmospheric levels of destructible scenery, avoid mines and turrets, and battle 48 different robot types from lowly Guardbots to the latest in Assassins, Special Ops and Battledroids.

*Offer ends January 16th at 10AM Pacific time.
